dialog.body: Public Works, this is Denise.
Good afternoon. My name is Alan Wilcox. I am calling because my recycling bin was damaged by the truck this morning. The lid is torn off and one side of the bin is cracked.
Oh, that's no good. Okay, so it happened at pickup today, you're saying? The truck did it?

Yes. I put the bin at the curb last night. This morning I found it lying in the street, about ten feet from where I left it. The lid was separate from the bin, and the crack goes down the side. I did not see the truck do it, but nothing else could have done this.
Sure, that makes sense. It happens, they grab them with the arm and sometimes they get dropped or crushed. Is it the recycling bin or the trash barrel?
The recycling bin. The blue one. The trash container is fine.
Okay. And is this a house you live in, or a rental?
I am the landlord. It is a rental property that I own. The tenants use the bin, but I am responsible for it. I would like to know how to request a replacement.
No problem, that's fine. I can take the request over the phone. I'll need the address where the bin goes, and then a name and number for you.
I would prefer not to give the address on this call. Can the request be made with my name and phone number only? Or is the address required?
Hmm. Well, the crew needs to know where to drop it off, so the address is really how it's tied to the pickup route. Is there a reason you'd rather not say?
I am simply asking what is required. If it is required, then I will provide it another way. Can I submit the request in writing, or through a form?

There's usually a request form on the city website, under Public Works, where you can put it in with the address. Or you can come by the office. I can also just take a message for the supervisor with your name and number, and they'd call you back for the address.

A message to the supervisor is acceptable. Please write that the recycling bin was damaged by the collection truck on Tuesday morning, today, and that I need a replacement. My name is Alan Wilcox, W-I-L-C-O-X.
Got it. Wilcox, W-I-L-C-O-X. And a callback number?
Okay, 401-555-0157. And I'll note the bin was damaged during collection, lid off, cracked side. Anything else you want on there?
Yes. Please note that I would like to know whether there is any charge for the replacement, and how long it will take. I need exact information, not an approximation.

I hear you. I can't tell you the timing myself, it depends on how many requests are in and what the crew has on the truck. If it was damaged by the city's truck, they generally replace it. The supervisor can confirm all of that when they call.
Understood. Is there a day when the supervisor usually calls back? Today, or tomorrow?
Most likely today or tomorrow. We're a little short with the holiday week, so it might slip, but I'll mark it so they see it. If you don't hear anything by Thursday, call back and ask for me.
Thursday. Good. In the meantime, what should I do with the recycling? The next collection is in one week, and I have no container.
You can use any sturdy container for now. A cardboard box or a plastic tub works, as long as it's not a paper bag that'll fall apart if it gets wet. Just mark it clearly so they know it's recycling.
That is reasonable. Should I put the broken bin at the curb also, or keep it?
I'd keep it until the new one comes, in case they want to see it. Just move it out of the street, though.
I already moved it. Also, I should say, I was not able to pick up all the pieces in time. The lid went partly under a snowbank on the corner. [pause] I only found it because my child saw it.
Ah, good eye. Well, does your child help with the bins?

Not usually. My child was with me because school is on break, and also because my child brought home the class hamster for the holiday. We were carrying the cage into the car when we saw the lid. That is the only reason we noticed.
Okay. A hamster in the car, in this cold. I hope it's staying warm.
It is inside the house. The cage is in the kitchen, away from the window. Thank you for your concern. [pause] Please return to the request. Is there anything else you need from me?

Let me read it back so it's right. Alan Wilcox, 401-555-0157. Recycling bin damaged by the collection truck this morning, lid off and cracked side. Needs a replacement, wants to know about cost and timing, and the address will be given to the supervisor by phone. That all correct?
Yes, that is correct. One more item. When the supervisor calls, will they identify as Public Works?
Yes, they'll say Public Works, Newport. It might come up as a city number or it might not. Just answer if you can.
Good. I will keep my phone available. Thank you for your help.
You're welcome, Mr. Wilcox. Happy new year, and tell the hamster we said hi.
I will. Goodbye.
